card.name: Page numbers and dollar amounts
card.fires_on: The colon or space after a journal volume number just before page numbers in citations, and the dollar sign before historical wage figures.

modes.label: Citation volume to pages
modes.description: The colon or space between a journal volume and the starting page number in a reference.

modes.label: Dollar sign before wages
modes.description: The $ sign before a pay amount in a historical account of Depression-era or past wages.

card.writes: It pushes toward Soviet and Cold War-era terms such as USSR and Soviet, and away from modern terms like Obama and GPS.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a number, either a page in a journal reference or a dollar amount in a history passage.
